title: The Town Where the Curse Is Lifted
pitch: Inside one Crawler town's walls, every human sees the Crawlers as people: children, grandmothers, a baker with too many hands to be anything but kind. Nobody knows which Celestial did it, or why.
Outside the walls, the Hellraisers are coming, and they still see monsters.
meta: Curse vs love. The AI Narrator improvises the rest.

arc.beginning: The party inside the town; its people; word of the Hellraisers' approach.
arc.middle: Why the curse lifted here (true love, somewhere in town), and what the Hellraisers will see.
arc.end: Defend the town, turn the Hellraisers, or bring them inside the walls to see.

opening: Open in the town square on market day, the party among Crawlers who look entirely human to them, as a rider comes through the gate with news of Hellraisers on the road.

zones.name: The lifted town
zones.summary: A Crawler town inside walls where the curse is lifted; the Hellraisers outside.

notes.text: Outside the west wall: the road the Hellraisers will come down.

objects.name: The town gate
objects.text: Oak and scrap. The townsfolk built it themselves.

approaches.label: Reinforce the gate
approaches.stakes: Hold it when the Hellraisers come.

objects.name: The baker's
objects.text: A baker with too many hands to be anything but kind. Everyone here loves him.

approaches.label: Ask about the curse
approaches.stakes: When it lifted, and what changed that day.
